title: The Happiness Hypothesis
subtitle: Putting Ancient Wisdom to the Test of Modern Science
author: Jonathan Haidt
description: 'The Happiness Hypothesis' exposes traditional wisdom to the scrutiny of modern science, delivering startling insights. This work helps readers learn that virtue is often not its own reward, why extroverts really are happier than introverts, and why conscious thought is not as important as we might like to think.
